posts.title: Baghdad to Host the 9th Annual Scientific Congress on Rheumatic Diseases
posts.excerpt: The Board of Directors of the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health is honored to invite colleagues, consultants and physicians specializing in rheumatic diseases, rehabilitation specialists, and postgraduate students to participate in the 9th Annual Scientific Congress on Rheumatic Diseases, held under the theme: "Future Prospects for Rheumatology in Iraq: Innovation, Inspiration, and Impact" This year's conference will provide a high-level interactive platform to discuss genetic and...
posts.contentText: The Board of Directors of the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health is honored to invite colleagues, consultants and physicians specializing in rheumatic diseases, rehabilitation specialists, and postgraduate students to participate in the 9th Annual Scientific Congress on Rheumatic Diseases, held under the theme: "Future Prospects for Rheumatology in Iraq: Innovation, Inspiration, and Impact" This year's conference will provide a high-level interactive platform to discuss genetic and immunological interventions that cause diseases, and to evaluate the efficacy of modern conventional, biological, and targeted therapies, aiming to bridge the gap between laboratory research and clinical practice in the field of rheumatology in Iraq Date: October 15-16, 2026 Location: Heart of the World Hotel / Baghdad

textData.text: The Board of Directors of the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health is honored to invite colleagues, consultants and physicians specializing in rheumatic diseases, rehabilitation specialists, and postgraduate students to participate in the 9th Annual Scientific Congress on Rheumatic Diseases, held under the theme:
"Future Prospects for Rheumatology in Iraq: Innovation, Inspiration, and Impact"

This year's conference will provide a high-level interactive platform to discuss genetic and immunological interventions that cause diseases, and to evaluate the efficacy of modern conventional, biological, and targeted therapies, aiming to bridge the gap between laboratory research and clinical practice in the field of rheumatology in Iraq
Location: Heart of the World Hotel / Baghdad

posts.title: International Iraq Spine Congress – Baghdad 2026
posts.excerpt: An important scientific event in Iraq in the field of spine: the International Iraq Spine Congress With broad participation from local spine associations, including the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health, the Iraqi Society of Orthopedic Surgery, and the Iraqi Society of Radiology and Medical Imaging. Also participating are regional associations such as the Arab League of Associations for Rheumatology, the Arab Spine Society, the Middle East and North Africa Spine Conference, and a number...
posts.contentText: An important scientific event in Iraq in the field of spine: the International Iraq Spine Congress With broad participation from local spine associations, including the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health, the Iraqi Society of Orthopedic Surgery, and the Iraqi Society of Radiology and Medical Imaging. Also participating are regional associations such as the Arab League of Associations for Rheumatology, the Arab Spine Society, the Middle East and North Africa Spine Conference, and a number of international research institutions specializing in spine medicine and surgery. The conference is accredited by academic institutions, including the Iraqi Board for Medical Specializations and the Arab Board of Health Specialties. The conference will bring together all aspects of the spine in Baghdad on April 10-11, 2026. April 9, 2026, will be dedicated to workshops and training. More than 20 international speakers from around the world will participate, sharing expertise and the latest technologies. Targeted specialties: * Orthopedic Surgery and Fractures * Neurosurgery * Rheumatology * Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation * Radiology * Pain Management * Neurology

Together, we move forward.

posts.title: 8th ILBJH Scientific Congress Highlights
posts.excerpt: “Uniting Expertise, Advancing Rheumatology” The 8th Scientific Congress of the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health (ILBJH) was successfully held from December 04–06, 2025 in Baghdad, bringing together 529 rheumatologists from across Iraq and the region. The congress welcomed distinguished experts from Egypt, Syria, Lebanon, the UAE, and the UK, alongside physicians from all over Iraq, fostering scientific exchange and regional collaboration in rheumatology. Watch the highlights from this...
posts.contentText: “Uniting Expertise, Advancing Rheumatology” The 8th Scientific Congress of the Iraqi League for Bone and Joint Health (ILBJH) was successfully held from December 04–06, 2025 in Baghdad, bringing together 529 rheumatologists from across Iraq and the region. The congress welcomed distinguished experts from Egypt, Syria, Lebanon, the UAE, and the UK, alongside physicians from all over Iraq, fostering scientific exchange and regional collaboration in rheumatology. Watch the highlights from this memorable event in the video above.

posts.title: First ISCD-Supervised Bone Density Measurement Course in Iraq – Baghdad, March 2026
posts.excerpt: For the first time in Iraq, we are pleased to announce the holding of a course on bone density measurement under the supervision of the...
posts.contentText: For the first time in Iraq, we are pleased to announce the holding of a course on bone density measurement under the supervision of the International Society for Clinical Densitometry (ISCD) and with the participation of internationally accredited experts in this field The course will be held in person from March 26-27, 2026, in the beloved capital, Baghdad The link to participate, along with details, will be sent in the next few weeks, Inshallah We eagerly look forward to this important scientific event, which aims to advance medical practice in the field of bone health in our region

textData.text: For the first time in Iraq, we are pleased to announce the holding of a course on bone density measurement under the supervision of the International Society for Clinical Densitometry (ISCD) and with the participation of internationally accredited experts in this field
The course will be held in person from March 26-27, 2026, in the beloved capital, Baghdad
The link to participate, along with details, will be sent in the next few weeks, Inshallah
We eagerly look forward to this important scientific event, which aims to advance medical practice in the field of bone health in our region

We eagerly look forward to this important scientific event, which aims to advance medical practice in the field of bone health in our region

posts.excerpt: 📝 Have your say in shaping the future of Rheumatology training! We are launching a regional survey to assess the quality, strengths, and...
posts.contentText: 📝 Have your say in shaping the future of Rheumatology training! We are launching a regional survey to assess the quality, strengths, and gaps in rheumatology fellowship training programs across the Arab League of Associations for Rheumatology (ArLAR) member countries. Your insights as a rheumatologist or educator are crucial to: ✅ Identify current training challenges ✅ Highlight successful practices ✅ Guide future improvements in fellowship programs 🌍 This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a collaborative effort that will enhance rheumatology education across the region. 🔗 Survey link in English:  https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfjxoIJfYjNNBkzT3kB-3I9Wt9ggsmOHBm7jc4AjfpqKuomlw/viewform?usp=dialog 🔗 Survey link in French: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScr3JLYqBZfC9jRR2QISOB2jbfIbGjeNcRuaGMe7r9bgfGneQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=101072862208144054036 🔒 All responses are anonymous and will be used for educational and research purposes only. Let your voice be heard—help us build better training for tomorrow’s rheumatologists! 💬💼 #Rheumatology #ArLAR #MedicalEducation #RheumTraining #FellowshipSurvey #Rheumatologists #ArLARVoice #RheumCommunity

textData.text: 📝 Have your say in shaping the future of Rheumatology training!

We are launching a regional survey to assess the quality, strengths, and gaps in rheumatology fellowship training programs across the Arab League of Associations for Rheumatology (ArLAR) member countries.
Your insights as a rheumatologist or educator are crucial to:
✅ Guide future improvements in fellowship programs
🌍 This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a collaborative effort that will enhance rheumatology education across the region.
🔒 All responses are anonymous and will be used for educational and research purposes only.
Let your voice be heard—help us build better training for tomorrow’s rheumatologists! 💬💼

posts.title: JSR and JOS Joint Meeting Spotlights Latest Developments in Osteoporosis Research
posts.excerpt: A scientific meeting was held on 17 January 2024, organized jointly by the Jordanian Society of Rheumatology (JSR) and the Jordanian...
posts.contentText: A scientific meeting was held on 17 January 2024, organized jointly by the Jordanian Society of Rheumatology (JSR) and the Jordanian Osteoporosis Society (JOS) on "What's new about osteoporosis?" Under the auspices of the President of the Jordan Medical Association Dr. Ziad Al-Zoubi The two societies honored Dr  Basel Masri (Founding President of the JOS and Past President of the JSR) for his constructive scientific contributions to osteoporosis locally, regionally, and globally.

posts.title: Exploring the Impact of Telehealth: Highlights from ArLAR Workshop at JSR23 Congress
posts.excerpt: Step into the world of telehealth with our exclusive highlights from the ArLAR Workshop on Telehealth, held during the JSR23 Congress in...
posts.contentText: Step into the world of telehealth with our exclusive highlights from the ArLAR Workshop on Telehealth, held during the JSR23 Congress in Amman, Jordan. This captivating workshop brought together experts in the field of rheumatology to delve into the transformative power of telehealth in patient care and practice. Through insightful discussions and practical insights, participants explored the innovative approaches and technologies that are revolutionizing rheumatology care delivery. From remote consultations to digital health solutions, these highlights provide a glimpse into the future of healthcare. Join us on this journey as we explore the impact of telehealth and its potential to reshape the field of rheumatology. #ArLAR #JSR23 #TelehealthWorkshop #Rheumatology #Innovation #HealthcareTransformation

posts.title: Relive the Highlights of ArLAR23 Kuwait Congress: Replays Now Available!
posts.excerpt: We are thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated replays of ArLAR23 Kuwait Congress are now available for your viewing pleasure!...
posts.contentText:
We are thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated replays of ArLAR23 Kuwait Congress are now available for your viewing pleasure! Whether you missed out on attending the congress or simply want to revisit your favorite sessions, we've got you covered. ArLAR23 Kuwait Congress was an exceptional event, filled with captivating insights, groundbreaking research, and engaging discussions led by renowned experts in the field of rheumatology. Now, you can relive those unforgettable moments and gain valuable knowledge from the comfort of your own screen. By accessing the ArLAR23 replay page, you can dive back into the incredible presentations, panels, and workshops that took place during the congress. From the latest advancements in rheumatology to innovative treatment approaches, these replays offer a wealth of information that can enhance your practice and broaden your understanding of the field. posts.title: Participate in the International CHANGE Survey with ArLAR Research Group
posts.excerpt: The ArLAR Research Group (ARCH) has launched an international survey, endorsed and adapted by ArLAR, to determine the extent to which...
posts.contentText:
The ArLAR Research Group (ARCH) has launched an international survey, endorsed and adapted by ArLAR, to determine the extent to which rheumatology healthcare professionals need support in career advancement, particularly as it relates to global equity. The survey is open to all rheumatologist practicing in Arab countries and takes only 5 minutes to complete. All responses will be completely anonymous, and by participating, you agree to allow ARCH to use your anonymous responses for medical education and research purposes. Don't miss this opportunity to have your voice heard and contribute to advancing the field of rheumatology!

Click the link to participate: https://surveymonkey.co.uk/r/3DRS9BL

posts.title: Saudi Society of Rheumatology (SSR) is pleased to launch the Annals of Rheumatology and Autoimmunity
posts.excerpt: Saudi Society of Rheumatology (SSR) is pleased to launch the Annals of Rheumatology and Autoimmunity (ARA). As we know, the scientific...
posts.contentText: Saudi Society of Rheumatology (SSR) is pleased to launch the Annals of Rheumatology and Autoimmunity (ARA). As we know, the scientific research and publication have been the foundation of today's knowledge. ARA will be an open access, international peer-reviewed journal. It is owned by the SSR, which is a national professional society in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. SSR was established on May 2010; since then, a continuous effort was made to become the leading organization in rheumatology in the region. ARA will be dedicated to improve the quality of healthcare by publishing the best quality science for rheumatology, autoimmunity, and related medical specialties. ARA will be committed to be a dynamic, professional, and innovative organization, to promote research and evidence-based practice in rheumatology and autoimmunity so that a firm scientific knowledge base will develop, from which more effective practice may be evolved. ARA will publish original research, clinical reports, educational information, opinion related to rheumatology, and autoimmunity. ARA welcomes submissions from national and international researchers and contributors. Although ARA will be the official Journal of SSR, the Journal will show and maintain editorial independence from SSR. Its content will be selected by editorial board and does not necessarily reflect the beliefs and policies of SSR. ARA will intend to serve medical and affiliated health personal from both clinical and/or basic science background who are involved in the field of rheumatology. ARA will be published thrice a year. We would like to take this opportunity to thank all those who helped in starting this new Journal.

posts.title: JSR - June 23 - How to overcome my rheumatoid arthritis?
posts.excerpt: دعوة مفتوحة للجميع تتشرف جمعية أطباء أمراض الروماتيزم والمفاصل الأردنية بدعوتكم لحضور الفعالية الموجهة لمرضى التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي...
posts.contentText: دعوة مفتوحة للجميع تتشرف جمعية أطباء أمراض الروماتيزم والمفاصل الأردنية بدعوتكم لحضور الفعالية الموجهة لمرضى التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي والعامة يوم الأربعاء 23 حزيران/يونيو 2021 على ‏السادسة مساء بتوقيت عمان-الأردن من خلال اللقاء المرئي الأول بعنوان "كيف يمكنني التغلب على التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي؟ " والذي  سيتخلله محاضرات ونشاطات توعوية وفقرة أسئلة واجوبة المواضيع جداً مهمة وستتطرق للحياة اليومية لمرضى الروماتيزم التسجيل مجاني! ‏‎ ‏‎ ‎شاهد مباشرةً من دون تسجيل ‏‎الانستغرام https://www.instagram.com/jsrheumato/ ‏‎الفيسبوك https://fb.me/e/S0H2JKUc ‏‎ اليوتيوب https://youtu.be/29WrU3gkye4 ‏‎ او شارك مباشرة في هذا اللقاء ‏عبر التسجيل من خلال رابط منصة زووم للتفاعل مع المحاضرين وطرح الاسئلة مباشرة على الهواء ‏ https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_zbOz1lDwQBKRkEo6VDlbJQ

textData.text: تتشرف جمعية أطباء أمراض الروماتيزم والمفاصل الأردنية بدعوتكم لحضور الفعالية الموجهة لمرضى التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي والعامة يوم الأربعاء 23 حزيران/يونيو 2021 على ‏السادسة مساء بتوقيت عمان-الأردن من خلال اللقاء المرئي الأول بعنوان "كيف يمكنني التغلب على التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي؟ " والذي  سيتخلله محاضرات ونشاطات توعوية وفقرة أسئلة واجوبة
المواضيع جداً مهمة وستتطرق للحياة اليومية لمرضى الروماتيزم
او شارك مباشرة في هذا اللقاء ‏عبر التسجيل من خلال رابط منصة زووم للتفاعل مع المحاضرين وطرح الاسئلة مباشرة على الهواء

post.contentText: دعوة مفتوحة للجميع تتشرف جمعية أطباء أمراض الروماتيزم والمفاصل الأردنية بدعوتكم لحضور الفعالية الموجهة لمرضى التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي والعامة يوم الأربعاء 23 حزيران/يونيو 2021 على ‏السادسة مساء بتوقيت عمان-الأردن من خلال اللقاء المرئي الأول بعنوان "كيف يمكنني التغلب على التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي؟ " والذي  سيتخلله محاضرات ونشاطات توعوية وفقرة أسئلة واجوبة المواضيع جداً مهمة وستتطرق للحياة اليومية لمرضى الروماتيزم التسجيل مجاني! ‏‎ ‏‎ ‎شاهد مباشرةً من دون تسجيل ‏‎الانستغرام https://www.instagram.com/jsrheumato/ ‏‎الفيسبوك https://fb.me/e/S0H2JKUc ‏‎ اليوتيوب https://youtu.be/29WrU3gkye4 ‏‎ او شارك مباشرة في هذا اللقاء ‏عبر التسجيل من خلال رابط منصة زووم للتفاعل مع المحاضرين وطرح الاسئلة مباشرة على الهواء ‏ https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_zbOz1lDwQBKRkEo6VDlbJQ

textData.text: تتشرف جمعية أطباء أمراض الروماتيزم والمفاصل الأردنية بدعوتكم لحضور الفعالية الموجهة لمرضى التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي والعامة يوم الأربعاء 23 حزيران/يونيو 2021 على ‏السادسة مساء بتوقيت عمان-الأردن من خلال اللقاء المرئي الأول بعنوان "كيف يمكنني التغلب على التهاب المفاصل الروماتويدي؟ " والذي  سيتخلله محاضرات ونشاطات توعوية وفقرة أسئلة واجوبة
المواضيع جداً مهمة وستتطرق للحياة اليومية لمرضى الروماتيزم
او شارك مباشرة في هذا اللقاء ‏عبر التسجيل من خلال رابط منصة زووم للتفاعل مع المحاضرين وطرح الاسئلة مباشرة على الهواء

Kindly Note : As per government regulations only who have completed at least the first dose of the vaccine are permitted to attend the conference physically Seat in the hall is subject to availability on arrival.

posts.title: COVID-19 Survey
posts.excerpt: Dear colleagues, Kindly respond to this survey! It is part of the HARMONIC study conducted across the Arab countries under the umbrella...
posts.contentText:
Dear colleagues, Kindly respond to this survey!
It is part of the HARMONIC study conducted across the Arab countries under the umbrella of ArLAR, to evaluate the current status of rheumatology practice during the COVID-19 pandemic.
It will take only 3 minutes to complete but will help us improve and harmonize our practice!
To participate, kindly follow this link: https://rebrand.ly/HARMONIC-ARLAR-ENG Thank you,

posts.title: Lebanese Society Congress
posts.excerpt: The annual conference of the Lebanese Society of Rheumatology was held in Beirut on 26-28 September in cooperation with "Ten topics of...
posts.contentText: The annual conference of the Lebanese Society of Rheumatology was held in Beirut on 26-28 September in cooperation with "Ten topics of London Group" and the "Lebanese Society of Radiologists", who decorated the conference rooms with their active participation. Approximately 200 participants attended the three-day conference. The opening ceremony was attended by the representative of the Lebanese Minister of Health, Dr. Mohamed Haidar, the President of the Lebanese Medical Association, Dr. Sharaf Abu Sharaf and Dr. Basil Al-Masri, President of the Arab Association of Rheumatology Societies.

posts.contentText: Informal meeting of  ArLAR different committees at  the eular 2019 in Madrid, Spain on June 14, 2019.   11 members out of 14 of the board of directors, members of the Scientific committee, the ArLAR Francophone Group, the Pediatric Rheumatology Arab Group – PRAG and the Jordanian Society of Rheumatology-JSR discussed the ArLAR JORDAN 2020 Congress which will take place in Amman 18-21 March 2020
